renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] True awakening discloses things as they are: its rays reveal the true essence of world-objects. [1] In You, being-full, I the self enter bliss — ingress, not feeling. [2] Awakening discloses; entry is bliss; pūrṇa (full/complete) is the Lord's nature.

paragraphs.text: True waking-up shows things exactly as they are: its rays reveal the real essence hiding inside ordinary world-objects. And then the second half: inside You — You who are fullness itself — I, the self, walk into bliss. Note that bliss here is a place you enter, not a feeling you feel.
Put together: awakening discloses, and entry is bliss. And fullness — being full, complete — is simply what the Lord is like by nature.
